description: This file defines classes related to AT-SPI event handling, including EventType and a helper list class, with methods for parsing event names and checking subtype relationships.

classes.name: _ELessList
classes.description: A subclass of list that returns None for out-of-bounds indices instead of raising IndexError.

classes.name: EventType
classes.description: A class that wraps an AT-SPI event type string, parsing it into components and providing methods to access parts and check subtype relationships.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Parses the full AT-SPI event name into its components: klass, major, minor, and detail.

methods.name: is_subtype
methods.description: Determines if another event type is a subtype of this event type.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the event type.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the event type.
